t: A two-part grade 6 sky science lesson series built on Stellarium Web.
steps: Find the Science North Stellarium grade 6 lessons and open Part 1 and Part 2.
Print the handout for each student.
Open stellarium-web.org on a student device and try one location yourself.
Choose the offline pictures for any student without a device.
Share the Part 2 questions on constellations and Polaris.
Ask students to compare the sky at two different latitudes.
